test_title: PYST 73: SSC CGL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: According to the Census of India 2011, which group of Union Territories has the highest density of population?

options.text: Lakshadweep, Daman and Diu and Puducherry
Delhi, Chandigarh and Daman and Diu
Lakshadweep, Daman and Diu and Chandigarh

solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi, Chandigarh and Puducherry**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to the Census of India 2011, Delhi, Chandigarh, and Puducherry are the Union Territories with the highest density of population.
 
• Delhi has the highest population density among all Union Territories and states in India.
 
• Chandigarh, being a well-planned city and a union territory, also has a high population density.
 
• Puducherry, with its small area and high population, ranks among the top Union Territories in terms of population density.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Population Density**

 
 
• Population density is defined as the number of people living per unit area of land, usually expressed as persons per square kilometer or square mile.
 
• It is an important parameter to understand the distribution of population in a region and helps in planning and development.
 
 
 
• **Delhi**
 
 
• Delhi is the capital city of India and has the highest population density in the country.
 
• According to the 2011 Census, Delhi's population density is 11,320 persons per square kilometer.
 
• Delhi's high population density is due to its status as the capital, attracting people from all over the country for employment, education, and better living standards.
 
 
 
• **Chandigarh**
 
 
• Chandigarh is a Union Territory that serves as the capital of both Punjab and Haryana.
 
• It is known for its well-planned layout and high standard of living.
 
• The population density of Chandigarh is 9,252 persons per square kilometer as per the 2011 Census.
 
 
 
• **Puducherry**
 
 
• Puducherry is a Union Territory comprising four small unconnected districts.
 
• It has a population density of 2,547 persons per square kilometer as per the 2011 Census.
 
• Puducherry's higher population density is attributed to its small geographical area combined with a relatively high population.
